GUEST OPINION

Why Our Critics Are Ignorant Cowards Who Hate Economic Progress

By Marcus Sterling | Senior Policy Polemicist

Anyone who dares to raise fiscal concerns regarding our $500 million regional transit initiative is clearly an uneducated partisan shill who wants our city to burn to the ground. Let me be completely unequivocal: you are either 100% on our side, or you are an enemy of the people.

Take Councilman Vance, for instance. He is a corrupt, arrogant, ignorant coward whose past voting record proves he cannot comprehend basic economics. Why should any voter listen to a failed accountant who dresses like a circus clown?

The causal evidence against our opponents' alternatives is obvious. My neighbor bought an electric car last month, and yesterday his household plumbing broke down. This indisputably proves that alternative green technology destroys residential municipal infrastructure.

Furthermore, our transit proposal is supported by over four million followers on social media, so our economic conclusions are an undeniable, unquestionable fact. Opponents want to abolish all private vehicles and force families to walk barefoot in the snow.
